items.description: Install Vitest and setup initial auth store cache state
steps: Install Vitest as a dev dependency in the frontend.
Update the Pinia auth store to include state for Reminder Settings, timezone options, loaded flags, and in-flight promise tracker.
Update the auth store reset logic to clear the new cache state on login, logout, tenant switch, and support-context exit.
Write initial Vitest tests to verify cache reset behavior.
items.regression_notes: All 9 Vitest store tests pass. Build passes without warnings.

items.description: Implement store actions for loading and saving settings with context isolation
steps: Implement a load action in the auth store that fetches both Reminder Settings and timezone options.
Deduplicate concurrent load requests using the in-flight promise tracker.
Ensure late network responses do not populate the cache if the Tenant Context has changed.
Implement a save action that updates the cache only from the successful PUT response.
Write Vitest tests for deduplication, Tenant Context isolation, and save behavior.

items.description: Integrate silent preload in Subscriptions view
steps: Update the Subscriptions view to dispatch the store load action on initialization.
Ensure the preload is silent (does not block or show page-level errors if it fails).
Remove redundant local Reminder Settings state from the Subscriptions view.

items.description: Refactor Reminder Settings modal to use store cache
steps: Remove the modal's initial settings prop and direct self-fetching behavior.
Make the modal deep-clone cached Reminder Settings into a local draft when opened.
Show inline loading and disable the Save button if opened before settings are available.
Show a contextual error if the fallback load fails.
Read timezone options from the store cache.
Wire the Save button to the store update action, discarding draft changes on cancel.
